title: Welcome to Saint Collections
subtitle: Track your Myth Cloth collection, monitor restocks and versions, filter unreleased and prototype figurines, and follow real-time prices with a signed-in account.
collectionDescription: Explore what you own, discover what is new, track restocks, and filter by version, release status, and category to keep your collection moving forward.
signInTitle: Sign in to unlock the full experience
signInDescription: Log in from the account section in the left menu to access real-time price tracking, richer market insights, and personalized collection workflows.
morePlacesDescription: These areas are available based on your current access and can help you go deeper once you are ready.

mythCloth.label: Myth Cloth
mythCloth.description: Browse the full figurine catalog and jump back into your main collection view.

collections.label: My Collections
collections.description: Open your saved collections, compare progress, and manage grouped figurines.

charts.label: Charts
charts.description: See fast collection summaries, proportions, and visual breakdowns.

releases.label: Releases
releases.description: Explore release history by year and drill into the timeline details.

storeMatching.label: Store Matching
storeMatching.description: Review matched store sources and compare them against your figurine catalog.

manualMatching.label: Manual Matching
manualMatching.description: Resolve unmatched listings and connect them to the right catalog entries.

anniversaries.label: Anniversaries
anniversaries.description: Track commemorative moments and milestone events tied to the collection.

distributors.label: Distributors
distributors.description: Keep partner and distributor data organized in one place.

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.description: Manage role access and security controls when working on administration flows.

browseCatalog.title: Browse your catalog
browseCatalog.description: Start with Myth Cloth to explore versions, apply advanced filters, and quickly find released, unreleased, and prototype figurines.

trackOwnership.title: Track ownership
trackOwnership.description: Move into collections and purchases when you want to organize what you own and what is still pending.

exploreTrends.title: Explore trends
exploreTrends.description: Open charts, releases, and pricing to monitor market movement, restocks, and real-time prices when signed in.
